page_title: VER 0-1 SAL | Verona v Salernitana 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Thomas Henry (Verona) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Benoit Costil is prepared and dives to thwart him.
90+5' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) passes the ball onto Antonio Candreva, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
90+3' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+2' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Verona win a corner.
90' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Simy walks off.
87' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Michael Folorunsho is replaced by Jordi Mboula (Verona).
87' Today's match ends for Josh Doig who will be replaced by Juan David Cabal (Verona).
85' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

83' The Salernitana players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Salernitana will have an opportunity.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milan Djuric trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thomas Henry (Verona).
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Josh Doig (Verona) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is out of play. Salernitana will take a throw-in.
76' The referee blows his whistle as Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
72' A yellow card for a tackle by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
72' Verona are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The ball is behind the touchline and Salernitana will take a throw-in.
69' Verona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
64' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) brings his opponent down. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
63' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Josh Doig (Verona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Verona have a corner.
62' Tomas Suslov (Verona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
60' Here comes a substitution. Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Darko Lazovic.
60' Here is a change. Jackson Tchatchoua is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Filippo Terracciano (Verona).
60' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
59' That's the end of the game for Grigoris Kastanos, who is replaced by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
57' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) commits a foul after dangerous play.

48' 0 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
48' Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Darko Lazovic (Verona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
47' The Verona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Simy (Salernitana) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Maurizio Mariani signals.
45+1' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

45+1' Tomas Suslov (Verona) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Darko Lazovic (Verona) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
44' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
44' There's an opportunity for Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
43' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
43' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

42' Simy (Salernitana) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Salernitana.
42' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Salernitana for a penalty. Play continues.
41' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
38' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
37' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Antonio Candreva in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.
36' Federico Fazio (Salernitana) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

35' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Maurizio Mariani with no other option than to blow for a foul.
35' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana).
34' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) tries to find Antonio Candreva, but he puts too much power on the pass.
33' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Isak Hien (Verona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
29' Salernitana can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' The Salernitana players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition. Good work from Salernitana as they win a corner.
27' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
27' Salernitana take a short corner kick.
27' Salernitana are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. It will be a corner kick for Salernitana.
26' The game is interrupted. Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
24' Josh Doig (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
23' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Verona fail to score from a corner as Benoit Costil (Salernitana) leaps to collect the ball.

21' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Milan Djuric (Verona), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. Verona force a corner. They send men into the box.
19' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) latched on to a cross and struck a header just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

18' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
18' Darko Lazovic (Verona) will take a corner kick.
18' A cross into the box from Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is cleared. Verona will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

15' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Verona win a corner kick.

13' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) tries his luck with a promising long-range shot from a rebound, but the ball sails painfully wide of the right post. What a great effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
13' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
13' Salernitana are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. Salernitana get a corner.
12' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
12' Martin Hongla (Verona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
11' Tomas Suslov (Verona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
9' Good defending. Michael Folorunsho (Verona) tries to find Darko Lazovic inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
8' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
6' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' Filippo Inzaghi is forced to make a change. Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Norbert Gyomber.
4' The ball is out of play. Salernitana will have a throw-in.
2' Verona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has just begun.
Salernitana will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
